questions.story: Russo-Ukrainian war > Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war, United States and the Russo-Ukrainian war
questions.question: American diplomat Steve Witkoff recently held talks in Saint Petersburg with Vladimir Putin to discuss peace negotiations involving which country?
questions.explanation: The US envoy met with Russia's president to explore options for reopening diplomatic discussions over the war in Ukraine.
questions.context: Russo-Ukrainian war > Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war, United States and the Russo-Ukrainian war: United States special envoy Steve Witkoff arrives in Saint Petersburg to talk with Russian president Vladimir Putin about potentially resolving the war with Ukraine. Putin states he would resume U.S.-mediated trilateral peace talks with Ukraine and the United States, on or after November 10.

questions.question: Which long-running video game developer behind popular role-playing franchises is being shut down by parent publisher Electronic Arts?
questions.explanation: Electronic Arts confirmed it is shuttering its Canadian-based BioWare studio as part of wider industry cutbacks.
questions.context: 2022–2026 video game industry layoffs: American video game publisher Electronic Arts, which was recently bought-out by the Saudi Public Investment Fund, announces the closing of its Canadian studio BioWare.

questions.question: Prosecutors in Taiwan have charged five individuals over an alleged plot to attack a satirical performer who criticises which organisation?
questions.explanation: The indicted suspects allegedly took payments to harm an anti-CCP comedian in New Taipei City.
questions.context: Cross-strait relations: Taiwanese prosecutors indict five people for allegedly accepting money and planning to injure an anti-Chinese Communist Party comedian in New Taipei City.

questions.question: Energy regulators have given the go-ahead for gas production to begin at the Jackdaw offshore field in which body of water?
questions.explanation: The UK North Sea Transition Authority granted approval for energy firm Adura to start supplying gas from the site.
questions.context: The North Sea Transition Authority (NSTA) of the United Kingdom approves production from the Jackdaw gas field after energy secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh authorized the NSTA to grant consent, allowing operator Adura to begin supplying gas by late October.

questions.question: Students and educators held widespread demonstrations across major cities in which European nation to demand better funding and affordable housing?
questions.explanation: Protesters gathered in Greek cities including Athens and Thessaloniki over the rising cost of living and education sector investment.
questions.context: 2026 European unrest, Gen Z protests: Thousands of students and teachers march through Athens, Thessaloniki, and Patras in Greece to protest against the rising cost of living, calling for affordable student housing and more state investment in education.
